items.title: Is Newmont (NEM) Still Cheap After A 173% Three Year Gain?
items.summary: Newmont has delivered very strong shareholder gains over the past few years, which puts fresh attention on a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today. Is the current share price of US$106.87 in line with the cash flows the business is expected to generate? Over the past 3 years, Newmont has returned 172.8%, so a lot of future cash flow is already being treated as valuable by the market. items.title: Agnico Eagle Bets on Massive Gold Expansion Despite Rising Mining Costs
items.summary: Agnico Eagle Mines (NYSE: AEM) is targeting a 20%–30% increase in annual gold production into the 2030s, backed by four major projects that could add between 1.3 million and 1.5 million ounces of annual output.

items.title: Holding GLD For Stock Falls? Gold Missed This One
items.summary: SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) rose in 6 of the 9 S&P 500 falls of 10% or more since the fund began in November 2004. This fall, gold did not help. GLD lost 14.3% from the S&P 500's October 6 record through November 25.
